title: Preparation for Duty
description: Covers requirements before starting duty, including attendance, uniform, documents, PPE, equipment, roster checks, fitness, and lifestyle factors.

knowledgeUnits.concept: What is the requirement regarding attending duty?
knowledgeUnits.definition: Attend duty at the correct time.
knowledgeUnits.distractor1: Attend duty within 15 minutes of the correct time.
knowledgeUnits.distractor2: Attend duty early to allow for checks.
knowledgeUnits.distractor3: Attendance time is flexible based on workload.
knowledgeUnits.explanation: Punctuality is essential. Drivers are required to attend for duty precisely at the time specified on their roster.

knowledgeUnits.concept: What is the requirement regarding uniform?
knowledgeUnits.distractor1: Uniform is optional if PPE is worn.
knowledgeUnits.distractor2: Only the high-visibility vest part of the uniform is mandatory.
knowledgeUnits.distractor3: Uniform is only required when interacting with passengers.
knowledgeUnits.explanation: Wearing the full, correct company uniform is a standard requirement while on duty.

knowledgeUnits.concept: What documents must you have in your possession?
knowledgeUnits.definition: Relevant WON, PON, STN, WTT, Sectional Appendix, Schedule book, altered workings, Driver's licence, 357 Aide memoir.
knowledgeUnits.distractor1: Only your Driver's licence and schedule book.
knowledgeUnits.distractor2: Mainly digital copies are sufficient, physical copies optional.
knowledgeUnits.distractor3: The Rule Book, WTT, and Driver's licence.
knowledgeUnits.explanation: Drivers must carry specific operational publications (WON, PON, STN, WTT, Sectional Appendix, schedule, any altered workings) and personal documents (licence, aide memoir) relevant to their duties.

knowledgeUnits.concept: What forms should you have available?
knowledgeUnits.definition: Driver's report form, RT3185 (Sig/AWS/TPWS Irregularity), RT3177 (Modified Working), RT3190 (Emergency Special Working), DOO defect form.
knowledgeUnits.distractor1: Only the Driver's report form is essential.
knowledgeUnits.distractor2: Forms are only needed if an incident is expected.
knowledgeUnits.distractor3: All forms are now submitted digitally via iPad only.
knowledgeUnits.explanation: Drivers need access to specific forms for reporting incidents, irregularities, non-standard working arrangements, and equipment defects.

knowledgeUnits.concept: What PPE & Equipment must you have for duty?
knowledgeUnits.definition: HVV (High Visibility Vest/Clothing), Safety footwear, Full uniform, Hand lamp, Watch, PTS card/licence, Carriage key ('T' key), BR21 key, Master key, Sunglasses (approved), Spare glasses (if worn), Driver's bag.
knowledgeUnits.distractor1: HVV and safety footwear are sufficient.
knowledgeUnits.distractor2: A working mobile phone replaces the need for a watch and hand lamp.
knowledgeUnits.distractor3: Keys are only required if shunting duties are rostered.
knowledgeUnits.explanation: Drivers must be equipped with mandatory PPE (HVV, safety footwear), uniform, and essential tools/equipment including a hand lamp, watch, PTS card, various keys, sunglasses, spare glasses (if applicable), and a driver's bag.

knowledgeUnits.concept: What must you check regarding your roster and diagrams?
knowledgeUnits.definition: Check daily sheets in the notice case before leaving duty. Understand abbreviations like MOB, IMM, DISP, DP, AP, PNB, REL, RELD, PASS, TAXI, PU.
knowledgeUnits.distractor1: Checking the roster once a week is sufficient.
knowledgeUnits.distractor2: Abbreviations are standard and don't need specific checking.
knowledgeUnits.distractor3: Only check the roster if you suspect a change has been made.
knowledgeUnits.explanation: Drivers must check the daily sheets for their rostered duty details and any alterations (AW) before finishing their previous shift. Familiarity with standard diagram abbreviations is necessary to understand the planned work.

knowledgeUnits.concept: What actions should you take if unable to attend duty at the correct time?
knowledgeUnits.definition: Contact the depot manager as soon as you can to allow them time to try and arrange for cover.
knowledgeUnits.distractor1: Send an email notification at least one hour before the shift.
knowledgeUnits.distractor2: Wait until the sign-on time and see if you feel better.
knowledgeUnits.distractor3: Ask a colleague to inform the depot manager for you.
knowledgeUnits.explanation: Prompt communication is key. If unable to attend duty, inform the depot manager at the earliest possible opportunity to maximize the chance of finding cover and minimize disruption.

knowledgeUnits.concept: What are the fitness for duty requirements?
knowledgeUnits.definition: Must not be under the influence of drugs or alcohol, must have had sufficient rest before duty, and not be breaking hidden hours rules.
knowledgeUnits.distractor1: Must have passed the medical within the last 5 years.
knowledgeUnits.distractor2: Must feel generally well, minor fatigue is acceptable.
knowledgeUnits.distractor3: Must not have consumed caffeine within 2 hours of the shift.
knowledgeUnits.explanation: Fitness for duty encompasses being free from impairing substances (drugs/alcohol), being adequately rested to maintain alertness, and complying with working hours regulations.

knowledgeUnits.concept: What are lifestyle factors which could affect your performance at work?
knowledgeUnits.definition: Insufficient sleep, money problems, alcohol problems, depression, family problems, death of family/friend.
knowledgeUnits.distractor2: Hobbies and leisure activities outside work.
knowledgeUnits.distractor3: Political views and social media usage.
knowledgeUnits.explanation: Various personal and lifestyle factors outside of work can significantly impact a driver's ability to perform safely and effectively. These include stress, fatigue, mental health, and substance issues.

knowledgeUnits.concept: How would you replace uniform or equipment?
knowledgeUnits.definition: Fill out uniform order forms at the depot and give to depot manager/line manager. Contact driver manager or depot manager ASAP if equipment is lost or defective. Sign for new items when provided.
knowledgeUnits.distractor1: Purchase replacements online and claim expenses.
knowledgeUnits.distractor2: Report it at the end of the week during the team briefing.
knowledgeUnits.distractor3: Borrow replacements from colleagues until new ones arrive.
knowledgeUnits.explanation: There is a formal process for replacing uniform via order forms submitted to management. Lost or defective essential equipment should be reported immediately. New items must be signed for.
